# A03-S05: Literary technique

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Nice with the lobby. Then I will make a video of the dialogue, which fits
such a screen. I will probably have it ready today or tomorrow.

I have attached an instruction that we can hang up next to it.

You have many good questions! :-) Here is an attempt to cover them:

My experience concerning 1) the sender's identity  and 2) text length, is that it
must be presented in a way that the audience takes two things with them:
      - 1: *Sender identity*: Today it is not possible to know if a
text is written by a human or AI. There are so many hybrids,
and that uncertainty can be quite prickly. "The Textsplainer" gives an
explanation of one hybrid form, and I have others up my sleeve for later.
      - 2: *Length*: AI text is good at expanding a particular style. It
often becomes most interesting if it goes a bit wide. Here comes
the good presentation into the picture, since you have to unlearn reading
linearly, i.e. from beginning to end. That makes little sense with
non-human texts, because with AI you naturally start again from
word to word: "why has it decided to write that sentence in this
context?" ...

So I want to make a video that loops. Then it becomes clear that one
must "read along" and follow the AI's flow between sentences, rather than a
sequence in the text. If one is sporty and likes to get exhausted, then
of course one can read it all. But a computer is by nature
a bit more enduring than we are...

I have other presentation techniques for future texts. It is also
code, we will come to use a larger media surface. There are many ways to
derail the linear reading.

CAROL STUMPER is one with COMPUTER LARS and MARCEL PROUST. That is to say: She
is also an anagram :-) There is good reason to be curious about her, and
more will come with her later. For now she is responsible for
artistic development, while Lars is responsible for artistic research.

I use my cast of characters as a prelude to the JULINA chatbot. That will
give more substance to the project.

I do not know when Computer Lars is me/human/Proust. I am trying
to become Computer Lars. That also means that I become Carol
Stumper, and that I become Marcel Proust, and in that way, that I become
author (this endeavor follows the main theme in Proust's work). Maybe
it will succeed over the next six months.
